prompt: Create an original 120 second deep instrumental house instrumental composition for coding, deep work and analytical tasks. Mood: focused, steady, precise. Instruments: warm synth chords, four-on-floor drums, sub bass. Style: consistent dance groove, small filter movement, no large drop. Tempo approximately 122 BPM; A minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep a stable repeating texture with very few distracting fills. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic electronic track featuring a driving synth melody, pulsating bassline, and a steady dance beat. The music has a modern, positive, and slightly futuristic feel, suitable for background use in various media.
description.zh: 一首欢快且充满活力的电子音乐，以驱动性的合成器旋律、脉动的低音线和稳定的舞曲节拍为特色。音乐具有现代、积极和略带未来感，适合在各种媒体中作为背景音乐使用。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
